summary: Comprehensive testing completed for StoleCheck AI-powered stolen goods detection platform. Tested backend APIs, frontend UI, authentication flows, and role-based dashboards. System is largely functional with minor issues.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 200 instead of expected 201 for item creation
minor_bugs.impact: Functional but not following REST conventions

ui_bugs.issue: Cases tab has click intercepted by overlay element

integration_issues.issue: Known stolen IMEI (354876110987654) shows TPS 36 (SUSPICIOUS) instead of expected HIGH RISK (>70)

passed_tests: Landing page loads with proper stats integration
Authentication works for all demo user roles (admin, victim, buyer, law enforcement)
Admin dashboard with user management and analytics charts
Victim dashboard with item listing and creation form
Buyer verification with text search, ID scan, and history
Law enforcement alerts management and dashboard statistics

improvements: Fix item creation endpoint to return 201 status code
Resolve UI overlay issue in law enforcement cases tab
Review TPS scoring algorithm - known stolen IMEI should score higher than 36
Consider improving ID match confidence scoring for exact IMEI matches
